name: plan-waits-on-item
about: A blueprint piece can wait for an existing loop item: '#N' in its 'depends on:' line is an item, a bare N a piece. #1 is already open; piece 2's 'depends on: 1, #1' files #3 depending on piece 1's item (#2) and on #1, posted as waiting on both. A blueprint naming an item that does not exist is refused at the approve and files nothing; the plan stays at blueprint until engineering fixes it.
